mostWorthwhile.text: Breaking starch down in two stages was worthwhile: the shorter chains made the progression from food to absorbable glucose clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the three organs was straightforward but repetitive. The explanation after the last fitting gave the sequence more purpose.

surprise.text: The fat result clarified that bile disperses fat into droplets while lipase breaks the molecules apart; bile itself is not an enzyme.

arbitrary.text: None of my choices felt arbitrary: the marked slots and picture descriptions suggested each pairing. The organ fittings alone did little to show how their contributions reached the food.

continue.text: I would choose to continue to see how the digestion products cross the intestinal lining and reach the body. This chapter made those products clear but ended before absorption.
